title: Wait-only adaptive backpressure verification
scope: Verify the independently forceable legacy_current and early_delay adaptive_backpressure values, wait-only one-admission semantics, bounded observation and unified provenance, exact sample-scoped raw joins, safety fallback, cancellation and terminal authority, and force-legacy rollback without making a performance or active-behavior claim.
verification_method: Canonical SpecTrace validation, deterministic requirement-home tests, schema and semantic validation, and focused application-send admission, queue, flow-control, cancellation, disposal, terminal, and ownership correctness tests.
preconditions: Stage 0, all four Stage 1 axes, and buffer_copy_coalescing remain preserved.
receive_credit_publication and every adjacent applied policy remain legacy_current.
The stopped 55,658-row single-axis transform remains diagnostic_incomplete and untouched.
Performance measurement, campaigns, transforms, ML, CI work, push, active_internal, and production activation remain unauthorized.
procedure: Validate SPEC-QUIC-CRT-STAGE2-ACTOR-MEMORY, ARC-QUIC-CRT-0068, WI-QUIC-CRT-0069, and VER-QUIC-CRT-0070 against the canonical model and reciprocal trace links.
Build the affected runtime, test project, and raw host in Release before testing.
Verify the closed legacy_current and early_delay values plus invalid closed-set rejection.

Verify disabled, observe-only, shadow, forced-legacy, and forced-early-delay modes with forced, recommended, selected, applied, source, reason, safety, latch, fallback, and version fields kept distinct.
Verify legacy_current never adds a wait and early_delay adds exactly one dispatcher or actor turn only when an earlier admitted application-send operation remains queued.
Verify the decision is evaluated once before stream reservation or owner admission and cannot wait for an external progress event or delay twice.
Verify missing, stale, saturated, contradictory, invalid, and out-of-domain input falls back to legacy_current even when early_delay is forced.
Verify lifecycle and unavailable-continuation safety overrides preserve the existing terminal or failure completion.
Verify cancellation after posting wins, a stale continuation is a no-op, and no admission is resurrected.
Verify simultaneous behavior-distinct forcing of any adjacent adaptive axis is rejected.

Verify force-legacy rollback preserves immediate admission, hard limits, queue order, ownership, completion, flow control, congestion, pacing, recovery, cancellation, disposal, reset, FIN, close, and shutdown authority.
Verify the configured policy snapshot remains in a unified epoch even when no admission is observed.
Verify observation, epoch, raw, unified evidence v8, unified raw v8, and manifest v9 schemas.
Verify sample-scoped backpressure rows are retained separately and join by exact source-scoped connection key and operation sequence to one inclusive epoch range.

Verify missing, duplicate, orphan, and out-of-order raw operation records fail semantic validation and exact operation, delay, safety, fallback, queue, and capacity aggregates are recomputed from members.
Verify distinct epoch and sample counts prevent admission records from being mislabeled as epoch-independent outcomes.
Run focused existing application-send queue, flow-control, cancellation, disposal, terminal, and ownership tests.
Confirm no performance, campaign, transform, ML, CI, push, active_internal, or production action occurred.
expected_result: adaptive_backpressure is observable, shadowable, independently forceable, unified-row represented, guarded, and force-legacy rollback tested; early_delay can add only one immediately posted turn and cannot reject, wait for external progress, weaken authoritative limits, change ownership, or override cancellation and terminal behavior; sample and epoch evidence remains exactly attributable; and no active or performance decision is introduced.
status_summary: Focused implementation verification is clean: the runtime seam, unified v8 evidence, raw v1 sample stream, schemas, exact joins, 20 axis cases, and the 141-case affected correctness band pass in Release. The four changed or new SpecTrace artifacts pass the canonical model, ID uniqueness, and reciprocal trace checks; the repo-wide canonical validator remains blocked by 2,698 pre-existing corpus errors. Measurement and active behavior remain frozen.
